newsitem.title: USA: TJX Cos says shareholders approve split.
newsitem.headline: TJX Cos says shareholders approve split.

text.p: TJX Cos Inc said Tuesday its shareholders voted to increase the number of shares of the company's authorized common stock.

The action makes effective the 2-for-1 split in the company's common stock that had been approved by the company's board of directors in April, subject to the increase in shares, TJX said. The split, to be effected in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend, will be paid on June 26 to shareholders of record on June 11. The company also declared a $0.05 post-split regular quarterly dividend on its common stock payable August 28 to shareholders of record August 7.
